sources.title: Introducing Structured Outputs in the API
sources.evidence: Dated August 6, 2024 and explicitly states gpt-4o-2024-08-06 was released that day. Describes the new snapshot training for schema adherence, function tools and JSON-schema response formatting. This is the exact August snapshot, not the May GPT-4o launch.

sources.title: GPT-4o model documentation
sources.evidence: Complete Markdown fetched. The gpt-4o alias explicitly defaults to gpt-4o-2024-08-06 and specifies 128,000 context, 16,384 maximum output, text/image inputs, text output, function calling and file uploads. August snapshot is Deprecated; May snapshot is separately Shut down. A standalone dated-snapshot Markdown URL returned 404, so the explicit alias mapping supplies the binding.

sources.title: Prompt Caching 201
sources.evidence: February 18, 2026 guide by an OpenAI author, read in HTML and full Markdown. Section 2.1 explains OpenAI caching through Transformer attention stacks; section 2.2 explicitly includes gpt-4o. Applied to the documented default August snapshot, this supports broad Transformer structure, not complete block inventory, routing or counts. Archived applicability is pre-GPT-5.6.

sources.title: GPT-5.1 Prompting Guide
sources.evidence: Complete Markdown fetched. The none-reasoning-mode section explicitly identifies GPT-4o and GPT-4.1 as prior non-reasoning models. It distinguishes absence of dedicated reasoning tokens from visible prompted reasoning.

sources.title: File inputs
sources.evidence: Complete Markdown explicitly names gpt-4o as a vision-capable model for PDF ingestion, where extracted text and page images are sent to the model. Combined with the current alias binding and file-upload support, this verifies PDF as API document input rather than a separate native modality.

sources.title: OpenAI API deprecations
sources.evidence: October 14, 2026 notice explicitly lists gpt-4o-2024-08-06 for API shutdown January 14, 2027. Scheduled retirement is distinct from completed shutdown and from the separate May snapshot retirement.

sources.title: Introducing gpt-oss
sources.evidence: Indexed first-party article read after direct page retrieval timed out. August 5, 2025 release identifies gpt-oss as the first open-weight language models since GPT-2 and calls GPT-4o proprietary. Its parameter and architecture table describes gpt-oss only.

sources.title: OpenAI Services Agreement
sources.evidence: Current agreement grants limited service access and reserves service intellectual property in sections 2.2 and 9.1. Supports the descriptive Proprietary classification for the hosted API model; not a checkpoint license or a claim these precise January 2026 terms applied at the 2024 launch.

sources.title: Toward understanding and preventing misalignment generalization
sources.evidence: Full June 2025 interpretability paper downloaded and text-extracted. Appendix G.3 explicitly uses gpt-4o-2024-08-06 for full fine-tuning. Appendix D.1 and Table 3 describe an auxiliary SAE with 2.1 million latents and 64 active latents, not GPT-4o production parameters. No total/active production count or dense/MoE routing disclosure found.

sources.title: GPT-4o System Card
sources.evidence: August 8, 2024 system card describes the broader autoregressive omni model and its training/evaluations. Checked introduction/training and searched parameter/architecture terms; no production parameter count appears. Broader audio/video/image-generation capabilities are not transferred to this text-output API snapshot.

sources.title: GPT-5 System Card
sources.evidence: Downloaded and text-extracted later system card; inspected GPT-4o comparison references and searched parameter/architecture/count terms. Comparison columns describe evaluation performance, not GPT-4o total or active parameters. Recent ChatGPT GPT-4o variants discussed here are not assumed identical to the August 2024 API snapshot.

name.note: Retain the catalog display name combining official product and immutable API snapshot date.

developer.note: Official launch and API documentation identify OpenAI.

family.note: The launch places the August snapshot in the GPT-4o series; replace generic gpt.

release_date.note: Exact snapshot release is explicitly described as today in the dated August 6 announcement; May 13 is the earlier family release.

open_weights.note: Hosted API release; OpenAI calls GPT-4o proprietary and identifies later gpt-oss as its first open-weight language models since GPT-2.

license.note: Descriptive service/model classification, not an SPDX identifier or downloadable-weight license.

parameters_b.note: No total production count found in exact release/specification, later exact-snapshot interpretability research, or system-card comparisons. Auxiliary SAE latents, unrelated model sizes and leaked estimates are not model parameters.

active_parameters_b.note: No active production count per token or expert routing specification found. The SAE active-latent count is auxiliary and cannot populate this field; total and active counts are not equated.

architecture.note: Broad Transformer classification follows OpenAI's documented inference mechanism explicitly applied to gpt-4o, whose current default is this snapshot. Operational evidence establishes a Transformer attention stack, not a complete inventory, exclusively Transformer layers or dense/MoE routing. The exact-snapshot SAE research supplies no routing disclosure.

context_window.note: Explicit context limit is 128,000 tokens; 16,384 is the separate maximum output length. Alias mapping binds the specification to the August snapshot.

modalities.note: Text/image inputs and text output describe this API snapshot. Add PDF under the existing catalog convention for supported API files; it is processed into extracted text and page images. Do not transfer broader omni-system audio/video or image-output capabilities.

reasoning.note: The official prompting guide explicitly identifies GPT-4o as a prior non-reasoning model. This denotes dedicated reasoning-token behavior, not inability to perform reasoning tasks or produce prompted visible steps.

tool_call.note: Both the original exact-snapshot launch and current bound alias documentation explicitly support function calling.

sources.label: Introducing Structured Outputs in the API
Toward understanding and preventing misalignment generalization

patch.notes: The gpt-4o alias currently defaults to gpt-4o-2024-08-06. This snapshot was released August 6, 2024 with Structured Outputs; the original GPT-4o family debuted earlier. Its documented API context is 128,000 tokens and native input/output is text and image to text. PDF file inputs are converted to text and page images. Transformer attention is documented, while complete structure, dense/MoE routing and total/active parameter counts remain undisclosed. Auxiliary SAE feature counts are not production parameters. OpenAI marks this snapshot deprecated and schedules API removal for January 14, 2027; no live endpoint request was made.

summary: Verified the August 6, 2024 snapshot release, current gpt-4o alias binding, 128,000-token context, text/image-to-text interface, tools and non-reasoning classification. Corrected family and license, added broad Transformer architecture and documented PDF-file support, replaced generic description and recorded future API retirement. Total/active counts and routing remain undisclosed after later exact-snapshot interpretability and system-card checks.
